title: Chapter 183
text:
"What's wrong?" Yang Dian looked at the computer screen and was stunned.

The contents of the USB flash drive were a portion of the project information that Han Xiao had obtained after hacking into the research facility. All the research projects related to the Death Virus were written on the USB flash drive. The USB flash drive contained the information that Han Xiao had obtained after hacking into the research facility. All the research projects related to the Death Virus were written on the USB flash drive.

It also said that the exploration team that went to Robert's Forbidden Zone was just a team that went to dig for materials. The materials they brought back were used for the research of body strengthening.

"Is, is this for real? Could he be lying to us? "

"He can kill us easily. There's no need for him to lie to us."

Yang Dian and Ned's shock gradually turned into rage.

It turned out that from the beginning to the end, the two of them had been fools. They had been played by the people of the Louis Research Institute. They had naively believed the one-sided words of others. This made their persistence seem like a joke!

No wonder the mysterious mecha warrior didn't kill them. He must have thought that they were pathetic, so he let them know the truth.

Yang Dian was embarrassed and ashamed. He really wanted to find a hole to hide in.

They had always called themselves superheroes, but they were saved by a stranger who they thought was evil for the second time! If the mysterious man hadn't revealed the truth, they would still be in the dark.

"Too bad we don't know his name. Otherwise, I would apologize in person." Ned was annoyed.

Yang Dian nodded heavily. He called Kate and yelled, "So you've been lying to me!"

Kate was shocked. "What did I lie to you about?"

"You've been using us and making us work for you. The exploration team and the cure for the virus are all fake!"

"What are you talking about? Why would I do that? You think too much." Kate's tone was unnatural.

"I already have the key evidence. The research on the Death Virus is not for saving people!" Yang Dian repeated.

Kate said, "That's all fake. You must have heard the rumors!"

"You're still lying to us!" Yang Dian was furious. He repeated the project number.

After a moment of silence, Kate spoke again. His tone was cold, and he didn't want to pretend anymore. "So, you can do whatever you want."

"I …" Yang Dian was furious, but he suddenly froze.

"Hmph, superhero!" Kate's tone was sarcastic. He hung up the phone.

Yang Dian held the phone and was stunned on the spot. His entire aura changed rapidly.

Ned suddenly felt a chill down his spine. "Are you okay?" he hurriedly asked.

Yang Dian shook his head and gently put down the phone. He let out an inexplicable laugh. "I'm fine. What could happen to me? Hehe."

…

The research institute was in a mess. The higher-ups were sweating profusely as they negotiated with the military.

Kate was very frustrated. He did not expect things to turn out this way. No one had ever dared to have any ideas about the research institute. They had many financial groups backing them up. Anyone who dared to touch the whiskers of the tiger would have to face an all-encompassing search and capture.

Kate had already contacted the financial group behind him, and they were all furious about this incident. The other party claimed to be the executive officer of the Germinal Organization, Heisenberg, and was equipped with a mechanical suit with extremely high mechanical standards. The credibility of this claim was not low. Now that the Germinal Organization was like a rat on the street, it did not matter if they made enemies or not.

The financial group behind this decision decided not only to have the West Continent's intelligence network thoroughly investigate this person's whereabouts, but also to sponsor the expedition of the Six Nations and donate military funds.

The financial group behind this had such a big reaction because the stolen drugs were urgently needed by the leaders of the various financial groups. For this reason, they were willing to spend money to get it back!

Kate was already frustrated enough. He did not even want to care about the blame of the two superheroes. He did not care if they knew that they had been tricked.

Because superheroes would not seek revenge over such a small matter, Kate was very calm and fearless.

…

[Trial of a Hero] completed!

+ 40 Yang Dian Favorability. + 40 Ned Favorability.

Han Xiao waited for a long time, but there were no new notifications. "The reward is gone? What do I need the favorability of these two idiots for? "

He had never heard of these two people before. They were probably not important people.

Han Xiao was speechless. Although the reward was reasonable, why did he feel so annoyed? Even some experience points would be better than this.

"Forget it, it's just a small mission. The biggest reward is this pile of drugs."

Han Xiao lowered his head to look at the bulging bag in his hand and smiled to himself.

When stealing the drugs … No, when snatching the drugs, Han Xiao had cleaned out the exhibition room of Louis Research Institution. The good thing was that he could get almost all kinds of drugs.

After finding a random small hotel to stay in, Han Xiao checked that there were no cameras in the room as usual. He opened the bag and took out the different types of drugs and sat in a row.

"Let me see what's good." Han Xiao rubbed his hands. It was said that one could only be lucky when they were hot.

Green Lizard Drug (Medium Concentration 23.3%): Made with the genes of the Green Lizard. This is a lazy creature. After drinking it, one's mind will become calm.

"…" Han Xiao was stunned for three seconds. He then stood up angrily and threw it on the floor.

"Green my ass. What's the point of developing this drug? My luck is better than this even if I use my feet! "

Staring at this pile of colorful potions, Han Xiao inexplicably felt like a black cloud formed by a pit gas was covering his head.

"I hope the other drugs are reliable …"

He continued to touch. There were a total of thirty-four types of drugs. Fortunately, there was nothing else like the Green Lizard Drug.

Some of the more useful ones were not bad.

The High Concentration Death Virus Enhancer was much better than the one Kate gave him. The permanent attribute bonus was more, and the chance of awakening a rare talent was three times higher.

Rhinoceros Hormone: Extracted from the kidney of a rhinoceros. + 5 STR and + 5 END after injection. Duration: 5 minutes. Next injection within 30 minutes will not work.

Thunder Claw Beast Extract: Extracted from the secretion of a Thunder Claw Beast. + 12% Melee Attack for the next five attacks.

Grouper Plague Pathogen: Causes the user to be infected with the Grouper Plague.

There were three types of drugs here. Drugs that temporarily increased attributes, drugs that spread diseases, and drugs that permanently increased attributes were very rare. There were only the Death Virus Enhancer and the Falcon Potion, which increased DEX.

"Some of the drugs can only be used once, but some can be used repeatedly. The Falcon Potion is the former, and the Death Virus Potion is the latter." That was why players were so fond of killing bosses in Laubert's Forbidden Zone. Usually, it was a competition between big guilds.

You have used the Falcon Potion. + 3 DEX permanently.

There were four bottles of Death Virus Potion in total. He drank them quickly. His STR, DEX, and END all increased by four. That bottle of high concentration allowed him to awaken a rare talent.
